zones.name: Check-In Hall
zones.description: All airline check-in desks. Open 3 hours before departure.

zones.name: Security & Departures
zones.description: Passport control and security screening. Allow 30 minutes.

zones.name: Gates A1-A8
zones.description: All departing flights. Lounge access available at Gate A2.

zones.name: Zephyr Lounge
zones.description: Premium lounge with complimentary food, drinks, and Wi-Fi. Access with eligible boarding pass or day pass.

zones.name: Retail & Duty Free
zones.description: Duty free, island crafts, clothing, and travel essentials.

zones.name: Dining & Bars
zones.description: Three dining options including The Trade Winds Bar & Kitchen.

zones.name: Arrivals Hall
zones.description: Baggage reclaim, customs, currency exchange, and ground transport.

zones.name: Ground Transport
zones.description: Taxis, car hire, and hotel shuttles. All operators are licensed by AER.
